hold_text: Tier-2 fix to src/runtime/exit_head_shadow.py, the scoring function that feeds exit_head_apply.exit_head_verdict's live close decision (order-path-adjacent). Changes the module's process-global dedup cache from a set (returns None on a repeat key) to a dict (returns the cached record on a repeat key), so a second account sharing one order_package_id (a Stage-2 mirror pair) gets the same verdict as the first instead of a starved None. Held for explicit operator review per the Tier-2 permission gate -- this is not self-landed regardless of how mechanically small the diff is, because it touches a function on the path exit_head_apply.exit_head_verdict reads to decide whether to close a real position.
why: Fixes PI-20260926-96NDZSOD-0001 (twin-dedup mirror divergence, high severity, queued). MEASURED on 3 of 3 twinned live closes (trades table, 2026-09-26T21:19Z) that bybit_2's exit_head close was never mirrored onto bybit_portfolio, which closed by a different mechanism instead -- violating the Stage-2 rule that the mirror takes IDENTICAL trades. LIVE IMPACT TODAY: inert, because every currently-published exit-head artifact is stage=shadow (exit_head_verdict only acts on stage=advisory) -- this fix changes no order sent today. It becomes load-bearing the moment any exit-head artifact is promoted to advisory while a twinned account pair is in scope; the PI's own clears_when names this fix as an independent precondition for any such promotion. Adds a regression test (test_twin_account_sharing_one_package_both_get_the_verdict) that reproduces the PI's own repro (two calls to maybe_score_exit_head with an identical order_package_id and bar) and asserts both now return the same non-None record. Full exit-head shadow/apply/parity test suites (260 tests) verified green; no config, artifact-stage, or live-path change -- promotion itself stays Tier-3 and is not decided by this PR.
